title: YOLO Carriage
meta_description: Discover the perfect Rosemary Beach, FL vacation rental at YOLO Carriage, a luxury 2-bedroom, 1-bath Carriage House ideal for up to 5 guests. Located in the heart of Rosemary Beach, this beautifully appointed retreat is steps from the community beach acce
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private & Convenient Beach Access - Access to Rosemary Beach's Amenities - Gulf Views - 2 Adult Bikes YOLO Carriage House is a charming and private coastal escape located on the south side of 30A in Rosemary Beach, offering ocean views, a private balcony, and a short walk to the beach. This thoughtfully designed space features a king primary bedroom, a fun and functional loft with a queen bed and twin “fort” nook, and a full bathroom. Vaulted ceilings and an open-concept layout create a bright and airy feel, while the full kitchen makes longer stays comfortable and convenient. The living area includes comfortable seating, bar dining, and a Smart TV for streaming. Step outside onto the private ocean-view balcony to enjoy morning coffee or unwind after a beach day. Guests also have access to Rosemary Beach amenities, including private beach access, community pools, a fitness center, and the Racquet Club. Shops and restaurants are all within walking or biking distance. Perfect for couples or small families seeking a peaceful Rosemary Beach getaway. Sleeping Arrangement Carriage House - Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo - Loft Area, Queen Bedroom w/ Twin Bed Note: Carriage House guests do not have access to the private pool or other amenities belonging to the main house. Amenities are limited to those listed for the Cottage House only.
